text:
What are the results by which a person is classified as a stream-enterer,
a once-returner,
a non-returner,
a worthy one,
a pratyekabuddha,
or a tathāgata, an arhat, a perfectly enlightened buddha?
The Blessed One replied,
“Su­bhūti, all phenomena are magical creations.
Some are magical creations of śrāvakas,
some are magical creations of pratyekabuddhas,
some are magical creations of bodhisattvas,
some are magical creations of tathāgatas,
some are magical creations of afflictions,
and some are magical creations of karma.
Subhūti, because of this one of many explanations, all dharmas are magical creations.
He asked:
“Blessed One, what is called ‘abandoned’
is the result of stream enterer,
the result of once-returner,
the result of non-returner,
the state of non-returner,
the state of a pratyekabuddha,
the state of a buddha,
or the dharma of having abandoned all propensities to the latent formations of ignorance—are all those magical creations?”
The Blessed One replied:
“Subhūti, any dharma that is produced or stopped
is a magical creation.
He asked:
“Blessed One, what is a dharma that is not a magical creation?”
The Blessed One replied:
The Dharma that is neither born nor ceases is uncreated.
The Blessed One replied:
The unequalled nirvāṇa is uncreated.
